title_zh: 为擅借相机道歉并明确以后先问

scenario.label_zh: 承认擅借相机并商定修复信任的边界
scenario.goal_zh: 承认未经允许拿走相机造成影响，并同意今后先征得物主同意

context_zh: 朋友发现相机被擅自借走，两人谈清边界。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: You took my camera without asking. I needed it for my sister's visit.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: I'm truly sorry. I assumed you wouldn't mind, and that was wrong.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: You called the timing unfortunate in your message. The problem wasn't the timing.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: You're right. It was my decision. I've brought it back, with the battery charged.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: I need to be able to trust you with my things.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: From now on, I'll ask before borrowing anything. If you don't reply, I won't take it.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: That's what I need. Thank you for bringing it back.
